style: high-energy modern sing-along pop for families, 122 bpm, bright major key, punchy drums and big handclaps, bouncy synth bass, ukulele, marimba and bamboo flute hooks, warm friendly male lead vocal with a cheerful group chorus on every chorus, call-and-response, verses light and bouncy, pre-chorus builds with a rising snare roll, chorus explodes with full band and group vocals, short claps-and-stomps breakdown, final chorus modulates up a whole step with the biggest energy, vocals start right away on the first beat with the chorus, no instrumental intro, short punchy ending
lyrics:
[Chorus - full band, group vocals]
Panda, panda, munch, munch, munch!
Bamboo breakfast, bamboo lunch!
Forest friends, come sing with me,
Clap your hands, one, two, three!

[Verse 1 - light and bouncy]
The panda is black and white,
Eating bamboo, bite by bite!
The tiger has stripes, orange and black,
Stripes on its tail and stripes on its back!

[Pre-Chorus - build up, rising drums]
Who is next? Let's take a look,
Peek around the forest nook!

[Chorus - full band, group vocals]
Panda, panda, munch, munch, munch!
Bamboo breakfast, bamboo lunch!
Forest friends, come sing with me,
Clap your hands, one, two, three!

[Verse 2 - light and bouncy]
The monkey swings from tree to tree,
Swing your arms and swing with me!
The koala naps the day away,
Leaves for dinner, every day!

[Bridge - claps and stomps, call and response]
Munch like a panda! (Munch, munch, munch!)
Swing like a monkey! (Swing, swing, swing!)
Stretch like a tiger! (Stretch up high!)
Now wave your tail and say goodbye!

[Verse 3 - light and bouncy]
The fox has a tail so fluffy and red,
It curls up warm when it goes to bed!
Milo sings up in the tree,
Forest friends, sing along with me!

[Pre-Chorus - build up, rising drums]
Who is next? Let's take a look,
Peek around the forest nook!

[Final Chorus - key change up, biggest energy, everyone sings]
Panda, panda, munch, munch, munch!
Bamboo breakfast, bamboo lunch!
Forest friends, we sang with glee,
Clap your hands, one, two, three!

[Outro - quick and happy]
Munch, munch, munch! Bye-bye, friends!

meta.title: Panda Loves Bamboo! Forest Animals Song with Milo
meta.description:
Meet the forest friends with Milo the bluebird! The panda munches bamboo, the tiger shows its stripes, the monkey swings, the koala naps in a tree and the fox has a fluffy tail.
A forest animals song for kids: munch, swing and clap along. Ages 2-6.

The Animated Zoo makes gentle, colorful videos for little learners. New videos every day! Made with care for ages 2-6. Characters and visuals are animated with the help of AI tools and reviewed for kid safety before publishing.
